events.title: Demo Update - Steam Next Fest! (v1.1.0)
events.summary: To celebrate Steam Next Fest, a new demo update has been released with lots of new features and content! Try out a summoner build with the new pets and companions, and power up your characters by fulfilling their pacts!Pets & Companions4 new flute weapons have been added to the demo with the ability to summon companions to fight for youDogwhistle: Summons a dog that deals damage and reduces armor on hitFay Flute: Summons a cat that deals damage and bleeds targets on hitTurquiose: Summons a frog
